questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A body of mass 2.5 kg falls from a height of 0.5 m on a spring. If the spring constant of the spring is $1950 \mathrm{Nm}^{-1}$, find the maximum contraction of the spring.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: An elevator of mass 4000 kg carrying a box of mass 240 kg . When the upward tension in the supporting cable is 48000 N , calculate the upward acceleration and rising distance after 3 s from starting.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: Two heat engines are active at $400 \mathrm{~K}$ and $800 \mathrm{~K}$ temperature respectively. The specific heat of the fuel used in the two engines are $2000 \mathrm{Jkg}^{-1} \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$ and $1500 \mathrm{Jkg}^{-1} \mathrm{~K}^{-1}$ respectively. Two different effective matters of $10 \mathrm{gm}$ mass are used in two different engines.

questions.subject: physics

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A ball is dropped from a height of 60 m and after striking the ground it loses $75 \%$ of its energy, calculate its rebound height.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: A photon of wavelength $0.40 \mathrm{~nm}$ strikes an electron at rest and rebounds at an angle of $150^{\circ}$ with respect to its original direction. Find the speed and wavelength of the photon after the collision.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: The water tap is turned off after using. Even then droplets of water were falling. On observation it was seen that the diameter of every droplet was $4 \times 10^{-7} \mathrm{~m}$. A bigger water droplet is created by combining 8 such smaller droplets. If the surface tension of water is $72 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{Nm}^{-1}$, then (i) What will be the diameter of the bigger water droplet? (ii) What will be the increased temperature of water?

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: An electron moves with $10^{5} \mathrm{~ms}^{-1}$ velocity making $60^{\circ}$ angle with the magnetic field of 0.5 Tesla. Find the force acting on the electron.

questions.subject: physics
questions.text: Imu connects an electric heater of resistance $100 \Omega$ with A.C source of 160 V and 50 Hz , next Dolla connects it with D.C source of 120 V . Find the average voltage of A.C and which connection is more effective?

questions.text: At $27^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ temperature and $760 \mathrm{~mm}(\mathrm{Hg})$ pressure 0.5 g A gas possess 300 mL volume. At the same temperature and $770 \mathrm{~mm}(\mathrm{Hg})$ pressure 0.6 g B gas possess 400 mL volume. At the same temperature and pressure which gas has more diffusion rate between A and B ?

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.text: The effect of temperature on reaction rate can be expressed by $K=A e^{-E_{a} / R T}$. Here $K$ is the rate constant and $\mathrm{E}_{\mathrm{a}}$ is activation energy. The rate constant, K is $0.237 \times 10^{-4} \mathrm{~L} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ at $0^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$ and $2.64 \times$ $10^{-4} \mathrm{~L} \mathrm{~mol}^{-1} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ at $25^{\circ} \mathrm{C}$. Calculate the activation energy.
